_comment: Fixture, not live data. A realistic public aggregator listing feed: one page, complete coverage, the kind of free-text third-party mess the normaliser exists to absorb. Six entries covering an open listing, a listing with a relative deadline and prose salary, a duplicated id, a different id sharing a title, an explicitly closed listing, and one whose status vocabulary we do not recognise.

results.headline: Experienced Mason Needed for Residential Development
results.body_html:
Two experienced masons required for a 24-unit residential development at Bamburi. Block laying, DPC and finishing works. Must be able to read a simple working drawing.

Camp and lunch provided.

results.headline: Plumber - Immediate Start
results.body_html: Qualified plumber needed for a hotel refurbishment in Kisauni. Hot and cold water, drainage and sanitary fit-off. Minimum three years on commercial fit-outs.

results.headline: Experienced Mason Needed for Residential Development (Reference CB-4411)
